title: Cops Capture ‘Shoplifting Queen’ After Walmart Haul
description:
A suspected serial shoplifter was arrested after allegedly nabbing various grocery items from Walmart in Albuquerque, New Mexico. Police took Celina Cordova, 39, into custody after the alleged Walmart incident where investigators revealed she had multiple warrants out for her arrest for similar crimes. Cordova is considered one of the top 10 most wanted alleged shoplifters in the area, with some calling her the “shoplifting queen.” Detectives then interviewed Cordova about a suspected organized shoplifting ring in the area.
